newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai soybeans end mixed in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai soybeans end mixed in slow trade.

text.p: Shanghai soybean futures ended mixed in dull trading on Tuesday with many investors staying on the sidelines ahead of the Chinese lunar new year holiday, traders said.
The key January and March contracts did not trade today.
May rose 50 to 3,230 yuan per tonne, July fell 35 to 3,260, September dropped two to 3,288 and November increased 24 to 3,370.
Combined volume fell sharply to 13,300 tonnes from 53,100.
Traders said many investors were taking a wait-and-see attitude given the lack of market-moving news.
"The market seemed to be asleep today with few investors building new positions," one trader said.
"Soybeans are likely to maintain the same trend in the short term," he added.
